query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'by_organization',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT o.id AS organization_id,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.companies c WHERE c.organization_id=o.id) accounts,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.contacts c WHERE c.organization_id=o.id) contacts,(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.marker_event m WHERE m.organization_id=o.id) markers,(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot s WHERE s.organization_id=o.id) snapshots FROM public.organizations o) x),
 'reference_kinds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT source,CASE WHEN evidence_ref ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$' THEN 'uuid' WHEN evidence_ref IN ('channels','continuity') THEN evidence_ref ELSE 'other' END AS ref_kind,count(*) n FROM scoring.marker_event GROUP BY 1,2) x),
 'source_reference_check',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('uuid_refs',count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.evidence_ref ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$'),'uuid_refs_not_found',count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.evidence_ref ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.communication_messages x WHERE x.id::text=m.evidence_ref) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.communication_threads x WHERE x.id::text=m.evidence_ref) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.meetings x WHERE x.id::text=m.evidence_ref) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.person_key_moments x WHERE x.id::text=m.evidence_ref) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.person_memory_entries x WHERE x.id::text=m.evidence_ref))) FROM scoring.marker_event m),
 'duplicate_groups',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT marker_id,sense,count(*) AS n,count(distinct source) AS source_variants FROM scoring.marker_event GROUP BY organization_id,contact_id,account_id,marker_id,sense,evidence_ref HAVING count(*)>1) x),
 'untracked_dyad_snapshots',(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot s JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id=s.contact_id WHERE s.entity_type='dyad' AND NOT c.is_tracked),
 'account_without_admissible_dyad',(SELECT count(*) FROM scoring.score_snapshot s WHERE s.entity_type='account' AND s.score IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scoring.score_snapshot d WHERE d.entity_type='dyad' AND d.account_id=s.account_id AND d.organization_id=s.organization_id AND d.snapshot_month=s.snapshot_month AND d.params_version=s.params_version AND d.registry_version=s.registry_version AND d.score IS NOT NULL AND d.verdict_allowed AND d.reliability>=0.6 AND d.status IN ('actif','ralenti'))),
 'same_month',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT snapshot_month,entity_type,count(*) n FROM scoring.score_snapshot GROUP BY 1,2) x),
 'null_coverage_fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT min((axes_or_dials->'d_couverture'->>'value')::numeric) AS min_value,max((axes_or_dials->'d_couverture'->>'value')::numeric) AS max_value, count(*) FILTER(WHERE (axes_or_dials->'d_couverture'->>'value')::numeric=0) AS zero_values FROM scoring.score_snapshot WHERE entity_type='account') x)
) AS additional_integrity;
